messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired for service=inference-gateway-prod alert=error_rate_5xx window=5m threshold=15% link=https://pd.example.com/alerts/XYZ

pagerduty-bot: Paging rotation -> @alex (primary oncall). Escalation in 3m if unacked. :rotating_light:

alex: Acked in PD. on it. quick context please — is this regional or global?

jamie: grabbing logs + metrics. initial look: spike concentrated in us-west-2 frontends -> lots of 502/504s starting ~1744008650. tailing ingress:```
upstream_response_time: 0.001,0.002
status=502 method=POST path=/v1/generate host=api.redwood.example
error="upstream read timeout" backend=runtime-72
```

lee: Noted. There was a canary push ~22:14 UTC to the routing-layer (small percentage). Could be weight fallout or sidecar mem pressure. Checking kube events and sidecar OOMs.

alex: @lee any obvious rollout changes? If it's canary, do we have an easy rollback/route cut?

lee: I see a config bump to proxy timeout and a sidecar restart loop on runtime-72. kubectl get pods shows LIVENESS restarts ~5x.```
NAME             READY   STATUS    RESTARTS
runtime-72-xk9   2/2     Running   5
```

jamie: Traces show latency climbing on frontends 30s before 5xx flood. span:frontend->sidecar->runtime shows retries then upstream timeouts. Link: https://tracing.redwood/example/trace/abc123

alex: Customer impact? Any big clients complaining?

morgan: CS pinged a handful of customers on us-west that reported increased errors in the last 10m. No major SSO or data loss reports but a few mid-market integrations had failing calls. I'll send an initial customer advisory.

lee: Proposal: shift route weight for us-west traffic to fallback pool in us-east while we investigate sidecar restarts. Doing a gradual 50%->0 shift for safety. Executing route command now:```
# routingctl set-weight inference-gateway us-west pool-fallback 50
OK: weight change queued
```

jamie: After shifting 50% error rate dropped from 18% -> 6% within 90s. Continuing to reduce. Metrics:```
5m error_rate before=18.4% now=0.9%
```

alex: Good. Reduce to 0% and monitor. Also create a short-term mitigation log in the runbook. Link: https://docs.redwood/runbooks/inference-5xx-mitigation

lee: Reduced to 0% for us-west. Confirming rollout: routingctl shows fallback=100% for affected AZs.

incident-bot: Runbook step noted: mark incident_severity=sev2 and notify on-call rotation handoff in 30m.

jamie: Backend logs indicate TLS handshake errors with a subset of runtime nodes before they crashed. Suspect proxy sidecar TLS renegotiation bug + mem pressure. Collecting core dumps and kdump.

morgan: Sent update to affected customers: initial mitigation applied, errors reduced, working on root cause. Will follow up with timeline for a postmortem.

alex: For now, keeping Sev2. Actions: 1) collect sidecar logs + core dumps (jamie) 2) validate canary config and rollback if needed (lee) 3) customer comms & CS watch (morgan) 4) prepare postmortem template (alex).

nina: Taking night handoff in 30m. Nina will keep an eye on PD and reopen if anomaly returns. Nina: ack handoff and I have contact with runtime team.

alex: Leaving notes in thread: possible root cause = TLS renegotiate + sidecar memory leak triggered by canary config change. Next steps: correlate restart times with deploy events, run longer soak on canary, bump sidecar timeouts, add guardrails to rollout automation. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Pager cleared - auto-close scheduled in 1h if no new alerts. Archive candidate: no for now until postmortem completes.

nina: Monitoring. If things flare up I'll re-route traffic back and escalate. :thumbsup:
